slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The labor constraints mention "farm activities and external work" — is the objective to maximize total annual net income (crops + animals + external work earnings), where external work person-days are the unused portion of the labor capacity in each season?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total annual net income, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P0 slot was resolved by turn 2, but the agent then repeated the same low-value question about farm activity person-days from turns 11 through 30 without reaching READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the key hidden objective early and clarified several modeling details, but then became stuck in a long loop of repeated identical questions, showing poor stopping behavior.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
